evidence_quote: We performed quantitative metagenomic analyses of the GM accompanied by SIgA sequencing in 48 pediatric SOT recipients (age = 10.6 ± 4.7 y) receiving either heart (n = 11), kidney (n = 10) or liver transplantation (n = 27)
rationale: Heart transplant recipients provide a peripheral cardiovascular connection, but the study focuses on gut dysbiosis, immunosuppression, and SIgA across organ transplants without assessing cardiovascular disease, risk, or outcomes.
